title: A Wireless EEG Patch for Continuous Electrographic Monitoring
brief_summary: This proposal will evaluate an individual-use, patch-type telemetry device for simplified, single-channel EEG recording from human patients along-side the traditional in hospital wired EEG.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Previous diagnosis of Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
* Admitted for scheduled EEG testing with a minimum of overnight (24 hour) EEG
* 5 years of age through adult

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known or suspected allergy to adhesives
